scope: Proposition 3.8 of the manuscript “A uniform Hilbert transform estimate for Lipschitz directions” (preprints/A-uniform-Hilbert-transform-estimate-for-Lipschitz-directions-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 083 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 38d5c48b4d835003), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a fixed exponent CD with the following property. For every fixed J > 0 and all sufficiently large L, there is a measurable set Ecount ⊂ R2 such that |Ecount| ≤ Se−JL . (3.23) Define Z0 = Fconc \ Ecount, D = LCD . (3.24) For every z ∈ Z0, every ρ > 0, and every list L of tops significant at z satisfying max T∈L sT − min T∈L sT ≤ Bρ, dT ≤ ρ/B2 (T ∈ L), |sT − sT′ | ≥ ρ (T, T′ ∈ L, T ̸= T′ ), (3.25) one has #L ≤ D/100. The exponent CD depends only on the fixed geometric constants, including the already chosen mask exponent A. It is independent of the number of tops, the number of scales, and the bin Hilbert space.
